# Vessel data {#sec-vocab-vessel-data}

[Normative]{.status}

Terms for the data a vessel produces about itself — navigation, environment, machinery and systems —
for sharing in real time and for recording (@sec-app-recording).

On board, this data already exists on NMEA 0183 and NMEA 2000 networks.
This module gives it a meaning independent of those networks,
so that it can be shared and recorded consistently and mapped back onto any on-board network.
How it relates to the **NMEA data dictionary** depends on that dictionary's licensing (see [Licensing](index.qmd#licensing)).

::: {.callout-warning title="To be written"}
Scope of the first version (for example position, heading, speed, depth, wind, engine data);
how time series and sampling rates are represented; mapping to NMEA data dictionary terms.
:::
